name: SunkenHut
collider: walls: one convex/box hull of the log box (NOT the protruding log ends, casings or drips, so the corners do not become a ladder); roof: 2 tilted box colliders along the two roof planes (back slope ~30 deg after the tilt is the standable one, front ~38 deg); chimney box; Plants/Moss no collider
notes: Upright log cabin modelled whole (lower logs kept), then roll-tilted 3.5 deg toward the front, 5 deg toward +X, sagged ridge and drooping broken front-right eave. Door opening (front, under water) is a dark atlas quad; window pane atlas quad.
